newsitem.title: USA: Moore unit signs $100 million contract.
newsitem.headline: Moore unit signs $100 million contract.

text.p: Moore U.S.A. Inc, a unit of Moore Corp Ltd, said Thursday it signed a five-year, $100 million sole-source contract with MedEcon, a Kentucky-based healthcare purchasing provider.

Under the contract, Moore U.S.A. will provide MedEcon members with print and digital technologies and services. The contract guarantees a reduction in MedEcon's members' overall business communications costs associated with print and electronic documents, the company said.
Moore designs and manufactures business communications products and services.
